smells.finding: force_reap is a one-line body (return spine_rail._binding_transaction(...)). _release_child_plans is ~85 lines including its docstring (~55 lines of actual code: setup, a declaration loop, a scan loop) -- proportionate to implementing three documented safety properties (lineage, honest non-owner release, escape refusal) as one cohesive unit; no block is doing unrelated work that would clarify by extraction beyond the duplication flagged separately below.
No classes added; two module-level functions.

The realpath-containment check is repeated verbatim (differing only in the trailing comment) in both loops of _release_child_plans: `try: resolved = candidate.resolve()\nexcept OSError: continue\nif not resolved.is_relative_to(resolved_work_dir): continue` appears once in the declared_children-building loop (over parent-spine tasks' child_checklist values) and once in the work_dir scan loop (over discovered *.json candidates). A small helper, e.g. `_resolve_within(path, boundary) -> Path | None`, would remove the duplication and give property 3 (escape refusal) exactly one implementation instead of two that must be kept in sync by hand. Non-blocking: each occurrence is 4-5 lines, the two loops walk genuinely different input sequences (declared child_checklist strings vs. discovered filesystem candidates) so the surrounding context differs, and the same class of duplication was already flagged non-blocking in g1-review's Fowler pass for _advance_and_release's three-times-repeated call/check/return shape -- consistent treatment. Recommend as a triage/cleanup candidate for a later pass (could be combined with g1's flagged duplication), not a blocker for this gate.

_release_child_plans reads only data it loaded itself (the parent spine's own dict, each candidate JSON's own dict) and calls out to _engine_call (its own module's choke point) rather than reaching into checklist_engine's or spine_rail's internals. force_reap makes exactly one call into spine_rail's own public transaction helper, the documented library-reuse seam -- not envy of spine_rail's internals.

spine_path/work_dir/root/reason are the minimum necessary parameters for one release operation, matching the shape close_work and _advance_and_release already use elsewhere in this module (root resolves a possibly-relative spine_path; reason is caller-supplied per the handoff, not derived). Not a primitive group standing in for a missing domain object.

_release_child_plans returns a plain dict ({"released": [...], "unclaimed_active": [...]}) rather than a typed result (dataclass/NamedTuple); force_reap returns spine_rail._binding_transaction's own dict|None as-is.
